test_concat_frames: test DataFrame.concat along axis=1 verifies copy-on-write memory sharing between input frames and result columns
test_concat_series: test Series.concat along axis=1 verifies copy-on-write memory sharing between input series and result columns
test_concat_frames_chained: test chained DataFrame.concat operations verify copy-on-write memory sharing through multiple concat levels
test_concat_series_chained: test chained Series.concat operations verify copy-on-write memory sharing through multiple concat levels
test_concat_mixed_series_frame: test concat of mixed DataFrame and Series along axis=1 verifies copy-on-write memory sharing for each column type
test_concat_copy_keyword: test DataFrame.concat without copy keyword verifies default copy-on-write behavior shares memory for all columns
test_merge_on_key: test DataFrame.merge on a key column verifies copy-on-write memory sharing for shared and non-shared columns
test_merge_on_index: test DataFrame.merge on index verifies copy-on-write memory sharing when merging with left_index and right_index
test_merge_on_key_enlarging_one: test DataFrame.merge with how=left and how=right on mismatched keys verifies copy-on-write for enlarged joins
test_merge_copy_keyword: test DataFrame.merge without copy keyword verifies default copy-on-write behavior shares memory for all columns
test_merge_upcasting_no_copy: test DataFrame.merge with dtype upcasting verifies copy-on-write shares memory for unchanged columns but not upcast columns
test_merge_indicator_no_deep_copy: test DataFrame.merge with indicator=True verifies copy-on-write memory sharing for both input columns
test_join_on_key: test DataFrame.join on a key column verifies copy-on-write memory sharing between input frames and result including index
test_join_multiple_dataframes_on_key: test DataFrame.join with multiple dataframes on key verifies copy-on-write memory sharing across all joined frames
